name: Laasya Yatham
title: CS + Canfield Business Honors @ UT Austin
interests: Building at the intersection of software, product, and security.
summary: Laasya Yatham is a Computer Science Honors and Canfield Business Honors student at UT Austin who is passionate about building software that is fast, secure, and built to scale. Her internships have taken her from security engineering at Texas Instruments, where she built authentication and access management systems on Kubernetes, to network engineering at H.E.B., where she automated device upgrades for a team of more than 100 engineers. Across both roles, she learned to treat security as a design principle rather than an afterthought and to measure her work by the time and effort it saves the people who use it. Outside the classroom, she builds a safe night-ride app for UT students with Longhorn Developers and explores decentralized applications with Texas Blockchain. She thrives on challenging engineering problems, from kernel-level file systems to AI agentic workflows, and pairs technical depth with a business lens on real-world impact.

projects.title: SureWalk — Longhorn Developers
projects.description: Walk safety mobile app for UT Austin students. Features live driver tracking, ride requests, and fleet management built with the Samsara API. Contributing developer on UT's largest student-run dev org.

projects.title: HEB Online Deli Shop
projects.description: Prototype redesign of HEB's online deli shop with interactive features, 100% WCAG Level AA compliance, and a product database built via Python scripts. Presented to 40+ HEB team members.

projects.title: Raspberry Pi SIEM
projects.description: Physical SIEM server configured on Raspberry Pi hardware for real-time log aggregation, threat detection, and security alerting across a home lab network.

projects.title: P2Prompt
projects.description: Web client for comparing optimal P2P cross-border transfer routes across fiat and crypto rails. Reduced transfer costs ~10% by aggregating real-time data from Forex feeds, Jupiter DEX, and payment APIs.

projects.title: Decentralized Depop
projects.description: AI-powered decentralized secondhand marketplace built on Base EVM. Smart contracts enforce reputation-based seller fees and anti-fraud deposits; AI agents hosted as iNFTs on the 0g testnet automate vibe-based listing requests.

projects.title: Secure Network Design
projects.description: Multi-tier enterprise network design that scored 100% on Cisco Packet Tracer and cut projected infrastructure costs by 36% through re-engineered switch/router allocation. Hardened with WPA2/RADIUS auth, IDS, admin MFA, and NAS backup.

projects.title: RISC-V Processor
projects.description: Pipelined RISC-V processor implementation with hazard detection, data forwarding, and branch prediction in hardware description language. UT Austin coursework.

projects.title: EduMedia Mobile Application
projects.description: Cross-platform mobile app connecting students, parents, and educators. Features live chat, club management, school calendar, and shared galleries backed by Back4App cloud.

projects.title: Ext2 File System
projects.description: Kernel-level ext2 file system driver in C++ with full block indirection and concurrent coroutine scheduling across a 4-core kernel. LRU in-memory cache delivered a 95% speedup on sequential reads while staying correct under concurrency.

projects.title: BVH Graphics Visualizer
projects.description: Self-balancing Bounding Volume Hierarchy tree using AVL rotation algorithms for collision detection and rendering acceleration. Validated with 32 JUnit tests and 10,000+ fuzz-tested geometries.

projects.title: pseudo-lang
projects.description: Custom programming language built in TypeScript with a full lexer, parser, and AST. Handles mathematical operations and operator precedence, rendered inside a collaborative mobile IDE app.

projects.title: Central Texas Tourism Recs
projects.description: Full-stack recommendation site for Central Texas dining, history, and outdoors, backed by a custom PHP/SQL database schema and phpMyAdmin administration.
